scope: Complete per-glyph Korean dictionary order, direction, boundary and form crosscheck. Not exam-body certification.

entries.notes: 衤 five then 扁 nine. The dictionary opens 扁 with a long horizontal bar — 戸, width 39 — where every licensed corpus draws a short dot, 戶, width 12. That is a different stroke, not a different direction or order, so the glyph fails closed, as with 扆 and 牖

言 seven then 扁 nine. The dictionary opens 扁 with a long horizontal bar — 戸, width 39 — where Ja, its only candidate, draws a short right-running stroke, 戶, width 24. The same 戶 difference as 褊, and held on the same ground
